user_request: User explicitly selected per-token FW bottleneck32 and one10B formal run after validation; supersedes shared-state discussion and the cancelled r8 jobs.
budget_choice: One fresh10B formal run, no extra formal controls or1B pilot
data_note: Reuse the existing10B packed cache, same tokenizer/dev/test/seed/order and full10B LR schedule as earlier partition experiments; no new dataset download.
optimizer: Outer native MuonAdamW: Transformer, sharedQK, shared FW initial matrices in Muon; three log inner learning rates in unembedding AdamW without decay. Inner functional EMA momentum0.95 + Nesterov + NS5 + shape scale + post-NS positive lr. No inner WD/clipping/weight normalization.
initialization: Shared meta-learned gate/up/down; explicit differentiable rank-one initial binding of h0 into down matrix, zero momentum. First hidden read entirely from bound FW. Branch output matrices small nonzero std0.1/sqrt(fan_in); other backbone initialization matches vanilla seed42.
comparison_limits: One seed; bottleneck32 is a constrained nonlinear memory, no guarantee it preserves all past information.
Full-width per-token FW+momentum needs12GiB per2K sequence for one live state; micro16 and unrolled depth are infeasible in22GB.

Bottleneck32/micro1 uses768MiB per live FP32 FW+momentum state and a conservative state-only checkpoint-input estimate6.75GiB. Actual GPU training peak includes additional autograd, NS and activation memory.
FW computes and NS inFP32 initially, with exact outer autograd and no reference gradient clipping; attention/MLP remainBF16. This differs from reference NS BF16 rounding.
Small nonzero branch output initialization replaces vanilla zero initialization to avoid a zero first inner direction. Actual extra compute and memory must be measured.

gate.restart: r32 DFWR25->exit85->fresh process50, full305176-step LR horizon; no time-limit exit before the prescribed25-step boundary
gate.data_note: Diagnostics only read the existing cache prefix; formal training uses the full10B cache.

readouts.dfwr: Each attention and MLP produces delta only. Per-token target=old.detach()+delta. Analytic gradient retains old-old.detach path. Carry all3FW matrices and3momentum buffers across all16sublayers; next hidden solelyFW_updated(sharedQK(h)).

head_input: Original final RMSNorm after16FW replacements; ordinary linear vocabulary head.
state_semantics: Independent runtime theta and momentum per B,T; no cross-token or cross-example FW reduction; reset per forward/decode position; slow initial parameters shared/meta-learned; causal attention is the only token-mixing path.
normalization: One learned shared D->D QK projection, followed by parameter-free RMSNorm eps1e-5 inFW precision. q=k. No V projection. FW output has no internal residual or normalization.
binding: theta0 expanded pertoken; down += (h0-FW0(k0))*phi(k0).T/(||phi||²+1e-6). Then read FW_bound(k0). No external hidden bypass; no auxiliary outer loss.
outer_gradient: Full final NTP through all unrolled updates/momentum, delta, QK, initialFW and inner log rates. Only old target is stopped. Explicit partial inner gradient holds key/target as arguments; outer graph retains their dependencies.

miniworld.notes: Current main uses explicit memory banks in memory.py and outer muon.py; LACT inner FW not yet located

videochat3.notes: FastWeightSwiGLU analytic inner update; NS5 without momentum; FP32 master plus column normalization; recomputed backward optional gradient clipping

depth_memory.comparison: LDM is also per-token depth memory, but uses a linear RLS memory plus a retained residual stream; DFWR uses nonlinear SwiGLU, incremental stopped-old target, Inner Muon and no hidden residual. LDM residual-path ablations underperformed PreLN; DFWR success is unproven.
